findings.motion: Motion 9 To Concur HCS and H Amends (Senate Roll Call #439)
findings.note: Senate vote on Senate Bill 747, Elections Law Changes, to accept the House changes. Hunt is listed among the Noes. The motion passed 27 to 18. The bill is a broad elections bill; this review could not read the bill text, so whether it touches ID rules is unconfirmed. Saved as an election-law vote in general.

Senate vote to override the Governor's veto of Senate Bill 747, Elections Law Changes. Hunt is listed among the Noes. The override passed 30 to 19. The bill text could not be read here, so whether it touches ID rules is unconfirmed. Saved as an election-law vote in general.

Named as a primary sponsor, with Marcus and Meyer, of S892, Student Voter ID Grant Program/CCs. The text (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2023/Bills/Senate/PDF/S892v0.pdf) sets aside $500,000 for grants to community colleges to upgrade equipment so their student ID cards can be used as photo ID to vote in person under G.S. 163-166.16, and directs the State Board of Elections to review those colleges' applications for approval of their student ID cards. Referred to committee 2024-05-06.
